newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Telebras Jan-Sept net 1.980 bln reais.
newsitem.headline: Telebras Jan-Sept net 1.980 bln reais.

text.p: Brazilian state-owned telecommunications firm Telebras reported a net consolidated profit of 1.980 billion reais between January and September 1996, the company said in a statement.
Telebras also said its holding reported a net profit of 2.389 billion reais.
The firm said its consolidated profits rose 204 percent in real terms when compared with the same period of 1995.
Profit per 1,000 shares was 7.45 reais, up from 2.70 reais in the same period last year, it said.
The company's net operating revenue rose 59.9 percent to 9.108 billion reais in the first nine months of 1996 from 5.697 billion reais in the same period last year.
Gross operating revenue was 12.037 billion reais, a rise of 60.5 percent when compared with last year's January-to-September period.
Telebras' net worth rose to 27.542 billion reais from 23.067 billion reais.
